description: Defines a singleton class 'StateContainer' in the OrangeHRM installer module that manages session-based state information such as database configuration, user/admin data, installation progress, and session attributes during the installation or upgrade process.

classes.name: StateContainer
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for storing and retrieving application state and configuration data throughout the installer process, utilizing session storage.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute by name.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute by name with optional default.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a session attribute exists.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a session attribute by name.

methods.name: getAllAttributes
methods.description: Returns all session attributes as an array.

methods.name: storeDbInfo
methods.description: Stores database connection details and credentials in session.

methods.name: clearDbInfo
methods.description: Clears stored database connection info from session.

methods.name: isSetDbInfo
methods.description: Checks if database info has been set.

methods.name: setCurrentScreen
methods.description: Sets the current installer screen and optional upgrader flag.

methods.name: isUpgrader
methods.description: Checks if the installer is in upgrader mode.

methods.name: setCurrentVersion
methods.description: Sets the current version of the installer.

methods.name: storeInstanceData
methods.description: Stores organization and localization info in session.

methods.name: storeInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Stores initial registration metadata in session.

methods.name: isMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Checks if migration has been completed.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Invalidates the current session but preserves current screen and mode flags.
